name: GIT_REF
description: Git branch, tag, or commit to check out
acceptedValues: Branch name, tag, or commit SHA

name: TASK_PROMPT
description: Instruction passed to the coding agent

name: KASEKI_MODEL
description: LLM model used for agent execution

name: KASEKI_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
description: Maximum agent execution time in seconds

name: KASEKI_CAVEMAN
description: Legacy switch for terse communication guidance

name: KASEKI_CAVEMAN_LEVEL
description: Soft prompt and tool-output reduction level

name: KASEKI_CAVEMAN_ROUTER
description: Enable or disable JEV routing for large tool results

name: KASEKI_CAVEMAN_ROUTER_MIN_CHARS
description: Minimum result size for the legacy JEV tool-output router; semantic routing uses its token threshold

name: KASEKI_CAVEMAN_ROUTER_TIMEOUT_MS
description: Maximum wait for one dynamic tool-output routing decision

name: KASEKI_CAVEMAN_ROUTER_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
description: Minimum choice confidence for a local transform in the legacy tool-output router

name: KASEKI_SEMANTIC_CONTEXT_ROUTER_ENABLED
description: Enable semantic disposition decisions for large coding-phase tool results
acceptedValues: `0` (use existing Caveman routing) or `1` (enable semantic routing)

name: KASEKI_SEMANTIC_CONTEXT_MIN_TOKENS
description: Minimum estimated tool-result size before semantic routing considers JEV

name: KASEKI_SEMANTIC_CONTEXT_DISCARD_THRESHOLD
description: Minimum discard probability required to omit tool output or a scouting fact from active context

name: KASEKI_SEMANTIC_CONTEXT_CONDENSE_THRESHOLD
description: Minimum condense probability required to condense tool output or reduce a scouting fact

name: KASEKI_SEMANTIC_PHASE_TRANSFER_ENABLED
description: Enable bounded JEV routing of scouting facts as they enter coding context

name: KASEKI_SEMANTIC_CONTEXT_REEVALUATION_ENABLED
description: Replace stale large file-read results after a successful same-path file edit

name: KASEKI_PROMPT_TOKEN_WARN_THRESHOLD
description: Per-request context size that triggers a compaction recommendation

name: KASEKI_CODING_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS
description: Advisory context target for the coding phase

name: KASEKI_CODING_MAX_TURNS
description: Advisory logical-turn target for the coding phase

name: KASEKI_CODING_MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_TOKENS
description: Advisory aggregate tool-output target for the coding phase

name: KASEKI_CODING_OUTPUT_TOKEN_TARGET
description: Advisory generated-output target per coding response; not sent to the provider as a cap

name: KASEKI_SCOUTING_MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_TOKENS
description: Advisory aggregate tool-output target for the scouting phase

name: KASEKI_GOAL_SETTING_MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_TOKENS
description: Advisory aggregate tool-output target for the goal-setting phase

name: KASEKI_GOAL_CHECK_MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_TOKENS
description: Advisory aggregate tool-output target for the goal-check phase

name: KASEKI_RUN_EVALUATION_MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_TOKENS
description: Advisory aggregate tool-output target for the run-evaluation phase

name: KASEKI_DECISION_MODEL
description: Model alias used by Task Admission, Goal Check, Run Evaluation, and validation recovery through the shared DecisionService

name: KASEKI_TYPED_EVALUATION_ENABLED
description: Enable structured decision evaluation for Goal Check and Run Evaluation

name: KASEKI_GOAL_CHECK_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
description: Confidence threshold for Goal Check criteria

name: KASEKI_VALIDATION_RECOVERY_MODE
description: Validation failure assessment and retry policy

name: KASEKI_VALIDATION_RETRY_SAFE_COMMANDS
description: Exact validation commands eligible for a bounded automatic retry

name: KASEKI_VALIDATION_RETRY_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
description: Minimum confidence for a validation recovery retry
